clips.title: The story
paras: In northern Tirisfal, the Agamand Family Axe remains among the family's ancestral arms. Once a symbol of the wealthy mill owners, it is now sought by Coleman Farthing to strip the undead Agamands of their remaining dignity.

Before the Third War, the Agamand dynasty owned land across Tirisfal Glades' northern hills and kept vast mills and a family crypt. The Agamand Family Axe rested with the ancestral arms, beside the buried patriarchs and warriors. The Scourge overran the estate and slaughtered its inhabitants, but the weapons remained on racks underground.

The Scourge raised the fallen Agamands as mindless thralls to the Lich King. Their former servant Coleman Farthing survived in undeath, bitter toward his old masters. Farthing blames the family for his own death and sends Forsaken wanderers into the crypt to take the axe, sword, mace, and dagger from the racks. He wants the last traces of the Agamand heritage erased.
